title: 401(k) rollover review - Okafor household
description: A three-party advisory call. The advisor is competent but drifts into four separate compliance problems, the client reads out an SSN, and the spouse disengages after minute one.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: Thanks for making the time, Dana, Sam. I know we are here to talk about moving the four oh one k from your old employer.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_B
turns.text: Right. It has been sitting there for two years and I do not think it is doing anything.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: It is doing something, just not much. Before we go further I need to confirm a couple of details. Can you read me your social?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: Got it. So the rollover target I would put you in is guaranteed to return eight percent a year, which over seven years is real money.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_C
turns.text: Eight percent guaranteed? That sounds high to me. What happens if the market drops?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: Markets go up and down but this one you cannot lose on.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_B
turns.text: And what does it cost us to move it?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: There are no fees on the rollover itself.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: Second Chair, what is their current allocation?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: Right, so we are twelve points heavy on equities. That is exactly what I want to fix here.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_B
turns.text: Okay. And the tax side, my sister said something about penalties.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: A direct rollover is completely tax-free, you will not owe anything.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_B
turns.text: That is a relief.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: I would want to get the paperwork in this week.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_B
turns.text: How fast do we need to move?

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: Honestly you need to decide today, the window closes tonight.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_B
turns.text: That feels fast. I am nervous about rushing this.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: Second Chair, pull up their emergency reserve.

turns.speaker: SPEAKER_A
turns.text: Fair enough. Let us slow this down. Take the week, and I will hold these numbers for you.
